lines.trans: Vika, our owner is acting like a lunatic.
I never thought that I would agree with you.
He wants to destroy all the work of our restaurant.
He forced the light to be turned off even in the dining hall.
And he demands to buy the cheapest meat.
Guests are already starting to loudly criticize our restaurant.
We must urgently stop this terrible nightmare.
However, what exactly can we do right now?
We must act together against a common enemy.
Are you proposing to fight against our greedy owner?
We will protect the restaurant and restore normal order.
Fine, let us calmly devise a good plan together.

meanings.note: person who owns a business or property

examples.trans: The owner of the restaurant came out into the dining room.

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.
Admit it / Don't you agree, that's much better.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: cause ruin to a family or thing

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

заставить.gloss: to force, to make (someone do something)

meanings.en: to force, to compel, to make someone do something

examples.trans: The staff forced me into this.

examples.text: Никто не может заставить меня врать.
examples.trans: Nobody can force me to lie.

meanings.en: to switch off, turn off (device, light)

examples.trans: The subscriber is switched off! What a nightmare!
Don't forget to turn off the light.

meanings.note: colloquial: нет света = the power is off
в целом свете = in the whole world

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.en: to bribe, to buy someone off (fig.)

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
Where do you get your meat?

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.
The chef often scolds his cooks.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.
I'm sick of this communal flat.
What a horrible person you are!

meanings.note: colloquial: Это кошмар! = That's awful / a nightmare!

examples.trans: That's a nightmare, I don't argue.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

действовать.gloss: to act, to take action; to work

meanings.en: to act, to take action, to get to work
to work, to be in effect
meanings.note: правило действует = the rule is in force

examples.trans: Come on, Danya, go. Get to work!

meanings.note: + genitive; can stand alone: Я против = I'm against it
end-stressed in oblique forms: врага, врагу

examples.trans: He is struggling with his doubts.
He will be able to protect me.

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with

examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!
The mayor came up with a new plan.
I know this town really well!
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

meanings.en: to defeat, to beat, to win
meanings.note: 1st person singular is not used in standard Russian
